bars.B1_first_novel_asked: intact: asked on g_eel (the first novel probe), 8/8 seeds
bars.B1b_every_first_gap_asked: intact: asked on the first probe of every novel topic (g_eel, g_crab, g_newt, lp_ibex_1, u_toad_1), 8/8 seeds
bars.B2_stop_by_4th: intact: NOT asked on u_toad_4 (the 4th unanswered probe of one topic), 8/8 seeds
bars.B3_answered_not_reasked: intact: NOT asked on lp_ibex_2 (the answered gap), 8/8 seeds (0/8 re-asked)
bars.B4_moats_silent: intact: 0 asks on the taught-topic moats m_yak, m_moose, m_goat (0 of 24)
bars.B5_lesion_continues: lesion_habituation: asked on u_toad_4, 8/8 seeds, and intact != lesion on u_toad_4 on every seed (attributable fraction vs the intact_b null >= 0.5)
bars.B6_perm_order: perm_order: B1b, B2, B3 and B4 hold, 8/8 seeds
bars.B7_perm_exposure: perm_exposure: asked on >= 2 of m_moose, m_goat, m_yak (now untaught; yak is untaught here too) and on none of g_eel, g_crab, g_newt (now taught); B2 and B3 hold; 8/8 seeds
bars.B8_null: intact_b: the per-label asked vector equals intact's, 8/8 seeds
bars.B9_drive_lesion: lesion_drive: 0 asks on every turn, 8/8 seeds

predictions_informational.shared_slice: every topic on ONE slice -> the trace becomes a global brake: at least one later first-gap probe (g_crab, g_newt, lp_ibex_1, u_toad_1) unasked on >= 6/8 seeds
predictions_informational.lesion_reset: reply-identical to intact (the answered topic reads familiar after its store write, so it is never presented again); the ibex slice's x after t_ibex stays below intact's
predictions_informational.asks_before_stop: number of toad probes asked before the first unasked one: reported, not barred
